thread:
alexa_sales: Heads up - Prospect 'NorthSea' wants EU + CA residency for all inference, logs, and keys. Prefer hosted but must guarantee no cross-border egress even during failover. Need cost impact and timeline for presales.

pranav_eng: We can tenant-pin inference to eu/ca pools and route logs to regional sinks. Control plane is global by default; full control-plane locality requires Private deployment.

dina_privsec: Legal asks for subprocessor list, BYO-KMS support, and confirmation keys never leave region. Also whether audit logs/metrics are stored regionally.

marcus_ops: Ops can set routing to "no-fallback". Tradeoff: higher risk of outages if region capacity drops. Options: reserve capacity in both regions or go Dedicated. ETA: hosted pin + pools ~3 weeks.

alexa_sales: Can we give a ballpark uplift for hosted hard-pin?

pranav_eng: Ballpark: +15-20% unit cost for hosted hard-pin. Dedicated reduces per-token delta but has monthly commit. Private/control-plane-in-region is larger project (4-6w) + infra fee.

dina_privsec: BYO-KMS: supported for major cloud KMS but control-plane calls may require key policy updates or a regional key-proxy. That adds ~1 week if needed.

marcus_ops: I'll open a ticket to provision pools and KMS proxy if needed.

ticket-bot: TICKET-91234 created: "NorthSea - EU/CA tenant pin + KMS proxy prep"

alexa_sales: Great — I'll include hosted uplift and Dedicated alternative in the SOW, note the 3-6 week timeline. Tagging @dina_privsec for DPA follow-up. Thanks.
